title: Airy Syrian Chicken Kebabs
description: A light and festive Syrian dish featuring mascarpone and double-fry KFC style chicken, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together mascarpone cheese, white wine, olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the mascarpone mixture.
Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Dip each skewer into the KFC style breading mixture, shaking off any excess.
Double fry the chicken skewers in hot oil until they are golden brown and crispy.
Place the skewers in a ramekin and bake in the oven for 10 minutes.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
